content:
Things is back with a nice new update after just a few weeks. The excellent project management app from Cultured Code is releasing support for iOS 27, macOS 27, and Apple’s other OS 27 updates coming out today. This includes Siri AI integration, a new widget size, and more.

Things is ready for iOS 27 and Siri AI on day one

Last month, Things 3.23 introduced a highly requested update to repeating to-dos.

Today’s release is all about iOS 27, iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, and the new Siri.

Things 3.24 includes support for the new OS updates as well as Siri and Spotlight integration and more. Here’s what’s new:

  • Full integration with the new Siri (please check if it’s available on your device).
  • Full integration with Spotlight, your device’s built-in search.
  • More snoozing options for notifications, with more suitable durations.
  • A new extra-tall widget to see longer lists.
  • Various other compatibility improvements for the new OS.

And here’s a look at the new version in action:

You can learn more about Things here. New versions for iPad, iPhone, Apple Watch, and Mac are already on the App Store. Apple is expected to release its OS updates around 10 am PT/1 pm ET.
